title: Automated photographic analysis of inferior oblique overaction based on deep learning
summary: In 106 eyes from 72 patients, automated measurements correlated with clinical grading and manual measurements, with high repeatability and low mean absolute deviation. The study validates this ophthalmic measurement task; it does not establish improved treatment or performance across other clinics and cameras.
ai_technology: A supervised deep-learning system measures inferior-oblique overaction from adducted-eye photographs using corneal-limbus height differences.
